module.name: Demo Projects
module.author: PythonAppFoundry
module.description: Demo module for project tracking. References the demo-contacts module to demonstrate a dependency cycle for the graph visualization feature.

if request.method == 'POST': projects = DynamicModel.get_or_create('demo_projects_list', { 'title': db.String(100), 'status': db.String(50), 'contact_id': db.Integer, 'created_at': db.DateTime, }) entry = projects( title=request.form.get('title', ''), status=request.form.get('status', 'planning'), contact_id=None, created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc), ) db.session.add(entry) db.session.commit() flash('Project added!') return redirect(url_for('demo_projects.list_projects')) html = '
